title: feat(spec, i18n): register the ask agent tool get_record_history and label it in every locale pack
body:
Fixes #32623
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSNTYTx2TpA25geuvV

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台工具名登记表 `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` 加上 `get_record_history`，11 个内置语言包各加一个 `chatbot.tool.get_record_history` 显示名（英文「Read the record history」）。
- 为什么改：cloud 的问答助手新增只读工具 `get_record_history`（cloud#4347），平台登记表不列它，cloud#4374 的一致性测试过不了；没有标签时聊天步骤会显示英文工具名。
- 风险与回滚：极低，纯新增一个名字和 11 行文案，不改任何已有值；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`（登记行与注释）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`（中文文案）、`.changeset/32623-get-record-history-tool.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`，预期 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`: `get_record_history` joins the `service-ai-studio` group in sorted position (between `get_package` and `list_metadata`), and the group's doc comment names it (read-only, one record's change history the user may see, restore still behind a confirm card, cloud#4347). This follows the file header's maintenance rule: new cloud tool name here, plus a `chatbot.tool.NAME` label in every pack.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one `chatbot.tool.get_record_history` entry in each of the 11 built-in packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant), placed in the same sorted position as the registry, i.e. right after `get_package` (the `tool` block mirrors the registry's order, so it sits a few lines above `open_record`, not directly beside it).
- `.changeset/32623-get-record-history-tool.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch (`Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry patch).

## Tests

- No test file was added: the registry's in-repo pin is `platform-tool-names.test.ts` (snake_case, no cross-package collision, no family-prefix clash, each group sorted), and the label pin is `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`, which reads the registry from the built spec and requires a non-empty label per pack. Both now cover the new name.
- Reverse check (one-off, not kept): deleting the `ko` label made the parity suite fail with `ko is missing chatbot.tool entries: expected [ 'get_record_history' ] to deeply equal []`; restored from `HEAD`, blob hash matched.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-② measured on the built declaration closure: `dist/system/index.d.ts` declares `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>`, so the declaration bytes do not move; the widening is in the published runtime value (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` / `isPlatformProvidedToolName` now accept one more name, which the lint R7 rule and the MCP bridge read). The claim's `yes` is kept on that basis.
- The claim and the card counted 13 or 14 locale packs; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` on main holds 11 (plus `index.ts`, `registry.ts`, `rtl.ts`), and the parity suite iterates exactly those.
- The en label reads 'Read the record history' rather than the card's suggested 'Read record history', to match the pack's sibling style ('Read the record', 'Open the record').
- Not changed: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` keeps its hand-held `PLATFORM_READ_ONLY_TOOL_NAMES`, which does not list this read-only tool; outside this card's surface, noted for the seat.
